title: The diagonal is a regular immersion
statement:
Let $f:X\to Y$ be smooth,
separated, of pure
relative dimension $d$, and put $W=X\times_YX$ with projections
$p_1,p_2$ and diagonal $\Delta:X\hookrightarrow W$. Then $\Delta$
is a regular closed immersion of
pure codimension $d$, and its normal bundle is canonically

$$
N_{\Delta/W}\;\cong\;T_{X/Y}
$$

(the relative tangent bundle of $f$).

proof.text:
By [sbc-thm-etale-local-normal-form], $f$ is etale locally the
projection $\mathbf A^d_Y\to Y$; on the model, $\Delta$ is the zero
section of $\mathbf A^d$, a regular closed immersion of codimension
$d$ with normal bundle the trivial rank-$d$ bundle, which under the
identification is $T_{X/Y}$. Regular immersions, their codimension
and their normal bundles are etale local (and compatible with etale
base change), hence the assertion.

lean.statement: theorem diagonal_isRegularImmersionOfPureCodimension (k : Type u) [Field k] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (aY : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) [IsSeparated aY] [LocallyOfFiniteType aY] [QuasiCompact aY] (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f] (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d f] : IsRegularImmersionOfPureCodimension (pullback.fst f f ≫ f ≫ aY) (pullback.diagonal f) d

The module states the current blueprint_update using the recorded IsRegularImmersionOfPureCodimension in the fixed separated finite-type field setting, including both stalkwise conditions and the definition's positive-codimension convention. The current blueprint_update removes the historical tangent-bundle conclusion. Rank-zero clopen regularity used by the item is handled directly there, without applying a positive-codimension predicate at zero.
